commit_message: Add ADR0126 Timeline foundation on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds the reviewed ADR0126 Timeline foundation on the exact current-main baseline: dependency-neutral 48 kHz scheduling/player state, stable Timeline IDs and persistence, deterministic compilation/evaluation, transactional authoring, capability/CLI/MCP surfaces, and camera-selection override groundwork.

The PR remains Draft. Follow-up requests on this same branch complete the first-release schema/Event semantics, production runtime composition, Project Rust integration, dedicated Sequencer authoring/preview, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation.
